interface.shortDescription: Find out whether AI agents pick, cite and can use your product,
interface.longDescription: Skills for marketers and developer relations teams. Test whether Claude Code and Codex pick you or a competitor, check whether agents can use your API, MCP server or CLI, audit whether AI crawlers can read your site, measure how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini mention and cite you, and read AI agent traffic from your logs. They work without an account; connect Lightsage to run them across more agents, on a schedule, and act on the results.
defaultPrompt: Does Claude Code recommend us or our competitor when developers ask for a tool like ours?
Check whether ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can read our docs site, and what to fix first.
Can coding agents finish our quickstart with our API? Test it and show where they get stuck.
